title: alectryon excelsus subsp. grandis
intro: Alectryon excelsus subsp. grandis, commonly known as the Tahina or the Tahina Palm, is a species of palm tree native to Madagascar. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Alectryon excelsus subsp. grandis include wound healing, antimicrobial activity, and anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
